texts.label: text
texts.orig: Adults with chronic heart failure, an LVEF of 40% or lower and an eGFR of 30 mL/min or more were randomized 1 to 1 to CardioNex (20mg once daily, raised to 40mg after 4 weeks) or placebo, on top of usual care. The median follow-up was 26 months. The primary outcome was the first of cardiovascular death or hospitalization for heart failure.
texts.text: Adults with chronic heart failure, an LVEF of 40% or lower and an eGFR of 30 mL/min or more were randomized 1 to 1 to CardioNex (20mg once daily, raised to 40mg after 4 weeks) or placebo, on top of usual care. The median follow-up was 26 months. The primary outcome was the first of cardiovascular death or hospitalization for heart failure.
